summary: Fence backward source insertion without a frontier advance

replay.detail: No automatic open/read/repair replay; explicit pages drain a captured delta queue.

schema.detail: Explicit asynchronous source capture refuses to certify inputs inserted behind its already applied prefix.

rules.detail: Canonical/admission/checkpoint rules unchanged. Unsupported rank/repair and local adapters fence or are refused.

compatibility.detail: Ordinary append/replication allocation remains unchanged; unsupported direct source insertion marks the opt-in async source unavailable.

downtime.detail: No live restart or existing-store conversion.

manual.detail: No production activation or data migration.

recovery.detail: Quota overflow, capture loss, incompatible metadata and unsupported mutation require explicit recovery; no automatic rebuild. Production authority, checkpoint, retention and ordered operators remain gates.
